update_weights_from_disk: update model weights from disk inplace without restarting the server
get_weights_checksum: get SHA-256 checksums of each requested module's weights
build_weights_api: build a FastAPI router with weight update endpoints for the diffusion engine

review_weights_api: review the weights API router and its weight update and checksum endpoints
